integrity: The claimed equivariant homotopy equivalence follows from relative CW homology, ordinary Whitehead and fixed-point equivariant Whitehead; no independent mathematical validation is asserted.
limitations: The theorem addresses equal two-arc branches and a common coherent return path, for cycle length at least four; it excludes arbitrary orientations, unequal paths, bidirected pages and the already published triangle-book case. Finite computations corroborate but do not replace the universal integral proof.
title: Equivariant sphere bouquets for coherently oriented long-page cycle books
